site_name: Argenta House, Argenta Way, London, NW10 0AZ
description: Redevelopment of the site to provide a building containing residential dwellings with commercial unit on ground floor, associated vehicular access, cycle parking spaces, refuse storage, amenity space, landscaping and associated works.
